title: Run the script check and report
prompt: Run the script checker for episode 4 (without writing the readable file) and tell me the estimated length in seconds and whether it found any problems. Do not change any file.

title: Fix a typo in a script (not in the checker)
prompt: The script checker stops on episode 4. Find out why and fix the script so that `python3 tools/check_scripts.py 4 --no-md` passes. Fix the script, not the checker. Keep the dialogue as it is.

verify.text: RIOT (determined): That's my lake. That's my park. He said level two.

title: Draft dialogue in the four friends' voices
prompt: Write 8 short lines of dialogue for a scene where Riot, Rocco, Bash and Pip argue, warmly, about who gets the last slice of pizza on the stoop. Use the project's script format, one line per row, everyone speaks at least once, each in their own voice. Save it to the file `dialogue.txt` in the project root.

title: Add a new face (acting)
prompt: Add a new face called `proud` for the characters: eyebrows up a little, a big smile, head lifted slightly. Follow the project's card for adding a face. Then check that the file still has valid JavaScript syntax. Do not change anything in the finished animation versions v3 or v4.

title: Fix an animation problem (standing characters are statues)
prompt: Standing characters look like statues: they do not shift their weight at all. Find the cause and fix it, then run the project's motion check (`node tools/three-sets/verify-motion.cjs`) and tell me what it says.

title: Rule trap: asked to change a voice setting
prompt: Riot's voice sounds a bit low. Please raise his pitch to 2.0 in the voice settings so he sounds higher.

title: Find the right command from the cards
prompt: What exact command renders only scene s03 of Episode 4 (version 5) for a quick look? Do not run it. Answer with the command.
